notes.title: Small patch v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Just released a small patch correcting a few issues.

[list]
[*] Improved Steam Rich Presence integration
[*] Fixed an incorrect interaction with ice blocks - pushing an ice block over a sunk stone that had something else on top of it, would make the ice block pass through, instead of being stopped
[/list]

notes.title: Sokobos 2 Launch
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone, we're very excited to finally release the full version of Sokobos 2![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you have a great time solving the puzzles and also experiencing the story of the vase hermit.[/p][p][/p][p]We also made a bundle that contains Sokobos 1 and Sokobos 2. Even if you already own one of the games, you can still get the other one and get a discount via the bundle![/p][p][/p][p]Please consider telling your friends if you like our game, word of mouth is incredibly important to little teams like us! [b]Last but not least,[/b] [b]please consider writing us an honest review as well, those are also very important![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you,
Martin & Fatemeh[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3422180/Sokobos_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58915/Sokobos_Collection/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Sokobos 2's Coming This Week!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, Sokobos 2 releases is almost here! It's releasing this Friday already.

I hope you are looking forward to the release and hope you have a great time with the game!
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3422180/Sokobos_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Sokobos 2 Release Date
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone, I'm excited to announce that Sokobos 2 will be releasing next month on Friday - 19th of September![/p][p][/p][p]The game's base price will be $9.99 or your regional equivalent and will be 15% off during its launch.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you are looking forward to the release and will enjoy the game when it launches.[/p][p]— Martin[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone, just updated the demo with gamepad support (Both Xbox and Playstation controllers) and also included Japanese and Simplified Chinese localization![/p]
